purpose: Record the governing readings and deviations surfaced by the A1R disposition, before Q00. No frozen gate value is changed; this file interprets, it does not amend.

C1_access_marginality.fact: A1 benefit concentrates at radius 1200 (O3_HOLDOUT median-of-pair-ratios 1.390/1.306 across two schedules); at radius 500 (O3_ACCESS, and by extension O2-like small-radius profiles) realized proxy ~1.06-1.09, below the 1.1 primary proxy bar on the stricter statistic in both schedules
C1_access_marginality.consequence: Q00/Q10 paired-CI-lower>1.0 may fail on ACCESS-like cells; the source change cannot be applied per-cell. Honest terminal space if final gates split: improvement_only or a radius-scoped claim, decided at Q10 with DECISION.md, never asserted as blanket throughput qualification.

C2_cold_gate_reading.flag: reviewer condition C2: frozen preregistration internally in tension (decision_rule includes maximum_cold_median_time_ratio 1.05; environment_freeze says warm-for-qualification with cold documented)
C2_cold_gate_reading.governing_reading: DECISION.md protected-cells clause: 'Cold process median must not regress by more than 5% without an explicitly bounded warm-only qualification; warm-only means no blanket-default promotion claim.' The packet therefore answers the question it was feared to leave open: the cold gate binds by default; an explicitly bounded warm-only qualification is the packet-sanctioned exception, and taking it constrains the final claim shape (no blanket-default promotion).
C2_cold_gate_reading.measured: cold cand/b0 median ratio reproduced 1.20/1.13 (two schedules), caused by one-time JIT of the 2 added scratch kernels (~1.3-1.4 s), warm-invisible
C2_cold_gate_reading.decision_point: Q00 freeze chooses the qualification route (cold-gate-conformant vs explicitly bounded warm-only); Z00 publishes the claim shape accordingly. Campaign owner may override before Q00; nothing in the packet requires stopping before then.

screening_block_deviation.fact: A1 screening schedule 1 (instrumented matrix) ran 4 paired blocks per cell against the DECISION.md text 'at most three paired screening blocks per revision'; schedule 2 (a1rp, the disposition dataset) ran 3 per cell conformantly
mitigations: candidate source was frozen at 7a27866 before any screening ran; no schedule-to-schedule tuning was possible or attempted
both schedules produced byte-identical outputs and consistent ratios; schedule 2 superseded schedule 1 for disposition
schedule 1 retained, clearly labeled supplementary diagnostics, in evidence/A1R/raw/a1r_*.json
hard budget bound held throughout: cumulative heavy wall 750.7 s of 14400 s
screening_block_deviation.discipline_note: future R tasks (F1R..A3R): screening must stay within 3 paired blocks per revision; instrumented pilots are not a substitute and extra blocks are not to be executed past the first conformant matrix

C1_gate_granularity.ruling: Gates evaluate PER MANDATORY WORKLOAD, never per-track averaged. Basis: DECISION.md run budget ('five pairs per mandatory workload') and primary gate phrasing; no packet text supports averaging across cells.
C1_gate_granularity.mandatory_set_rule: Q00 must fix the mandatory set as the FULL frozen workload set actually exercised by the screened-in tracks (O3_ACCESS, O3_HOLDOUT, O3_FLOW, plus O2 as protected small cell) - the set may not be curated to exclude cells a candidate is expected to fail.
C1_gate_granularity.cell_failure_consequence: A cell failing the 1.1/paired-CI bar does not reject a zero-semantic-risk source change that decisively passes another frozen cell, but it FORBIDS claiming that cell; the final publication claim is scoped to passing cells and every per-cell result is published. In the packet's terminal vocabulary this is the improvement_only/scoped-claim space, never qualified_proxy across all cells.
C1_gate_granularity.user_override: campaign owner may override this reading any time before Q00; recorded now so qualification is not surprised

C2_cold_gate.ruling: The cold gate binds by default (maximum_cold_median_time_ratio 1.05). DECISION.md's own exception is sanctioned: 'Cold process median must not regress by more than 5% without an explicitly bounded warm-only qualification; warm-only means no blanket-default promotion claim.'
mitigation_options_for_Q00: install-time precompile/warm of added kernels as a W00 build step (if Q10 cold diagnostics then normalize, the gate is met outright - no warm-only carve-out needed)
documented-cold status + explicitly bounded warm-only qualification, with the claim constrained accordingly
C2_cold_gate.user_override: campaign owner may override any time before Q00

W00_precompile_reading.flag: reviewer boundary flag: does install-time precompile/warm of added kernels collide with the campaign's 'broad cache' prohibition?
W00_precompile_reading.reading: NO COLLISION. The prohibition (campaign contract) targets result memoization - caching computed outputs. Numba cache=True caches compiled machine code, not results; B0 itself already ships cache=True kernels (H04/H05 runs populated NUMBA_CACHE_DIR from baseline source). Install-time pre-population moves the identical JIT compile to install time, adding no numerical surface and no result cache. Compliant as a W00 build step.
W00_precompile_reading.condition: if any W00/Q00 proposal goes beyond compilation warm-up (caching or reusing computed results across runs), it is out of bounds and must not be baked in
W00_precompile_reading.user_override: campaign owner may override before W00

R_task_spec_protocol.ruling: For every remaining R task (F1R, F3R, A2R, F2R, A3R): the screen spec is filed by the review owner BEFORE any execution, committed by the coordinator first, and only then does the screen executor run under a fresh heavy lease. This closes the a1r_/a1rp_ provenance gap permanently (A1R schedule 1 executed against an uncommitted interim team-lead spec).
R_task_spec_protocol.bare_window_instrumentation_rule: Inside bare disposition windows, in-run verification is config-level ONLY (harness-recorded engine_config_observed fields; zero perturbation). Any richer observation (concurrency counters, tracing, thread-pool inspection) is DIAGNOSTIC class: separate instrumented runs OUTSIDE the paired matrix, documented in the screen record, never entering gate math or the paired-block ceiling. Optional diagnostic controls (e.g. F1 K=1 structural negative control) are the executor's discretion under lease budget and earn no gate credit by design.
R_task_spec_protocol.basis: instrumentation inside timing windows is precisely what demoted A1R schedule 1 (v2_amendment.screening_block_deviation); this generalizes the discipline_note from a block-count rule into an instrumentation-placement rule

v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.trigger: F1R canary admission refusal BEFORE any window opened: 0.80*available read 2608.4 MiB against the ruled 2620 MiB refusal threshold (11.6 MiB short), availability trending down (2625 -> 2608.4 -> 2578 MiB over minutes). Cause is ambient owner-side memory pressure (~80% of 16 GiB: browser helpers, mail, workspace app, security agent), not campaign consumption. Refusal entry UNCHARGED; heavy wall static 824.8 s / 14400 s; canary record retained with ok=false and screen roots untouched (they do not yet exist) - kept as evidence the ruled guard fired.
v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.ruling: EXECUTION-ENTRY TIGHTENING, coordinator discretion, no frozen value touched: F1R gate-eligible execution opens windows only while 0.80*available >= 2800 MiB, checked BEFORE the canary AND BEFORE EACH gate-eligible block, the read recorded in that block's record. Rationale: at the bar, available >= 3500 MiB, so the fixed 2600 MiB watchdog holds the ruled ~111 MiB trip margin over the ~2489 MiB sel1024 flow peak (P5 planning assumption restored), and a falling ambient trend cannot invite a mid-matrix admission refusal whose ruled consequence is void-restart-whole. The ruled per-window admission refusal (0.80*available < 2620 MiB -> refuse) remains the binding hard gate, byte-unchanged.
v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.watch_authorization: h05-profiler polls availability READ-ONLY while below the bar: no windows open, no lease charge, no writes outside its own diagnostics record. Proceeds autonomously under the standing GO once the bar holds (canary -> screen-roots check -> block 1 cold -> blocks 2-3 warm), reporting terms unchanged (canary in, per-block completion, immediate stop-and-report on byte delta / config mismatch / admission refusal). One cumulative-wait status report due to the coordinator if the wait exceeds ~1 h.
v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.user_surface: Freeing ambient memory is owner-side action (browser tabs / desktop apps); the coordinator surfaced it in-session as OPTIONAL. The screen proceeds autonomously on recovery and does not block on owner action.
v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.process_note: filed BEFORE the first gate-eligible window per the R_task_spec_protocol principle (one committed schedule governing execution); interpretive record only - screen_spec.json rev 4 bytes untouched, freeze on evidence/F1R/ intact
